claims.quote: Type locality is 'Lagu Lagu creek, southern margin of Visayan State Coll. of Agric., about 7 kilometers north of Baybay, about 2 kilometers from sea, Leyte, Philippines', and initially the species was known only from that location.
More recent records suggest it to be more well-distributed, having been reported on the Japanese islands of Okinawa (Ryukyu Islands) and Yaku (aka Yakushima) much further north.
